changelog:
- Major update: Refocused skill to perform comprehensive coin-level due diligence using CoinMarketCap MCP tools.
- Old multi-layered framework for market/sector/technical reports has been removed.
- Now responds to prompts like "tell me about [coin]", "should I invest in [coin]", "DYOR [coin]", etc.
- Uses a systematic workflow: identify the token, fetch project info, price/stats, holder data, technicals, recent news; surfaces "green flags" and "red flags".
- Includes explicit instructions for completing research even if some tools or data are unavailable.
- Removed scripts and supporting files for legacy report automation and sector monitoring.
